# Objective
The goal of this notebook is to  


# Load the data
The data file is provided in the `data/test_data/` folder.  
The csv file contains one individual per line and several columns, with the column name appearing in the first line of the file.

```{r load_and_analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# =========================
# 1. Chargement des packages
# =========================
library(readxl)
library(effsize)

# =========================
# 2. Import des données
# =========================
df <- read_xlsx("data/Global_Jump_Height.xlsx")

# =========================
# 3. Vérification rapide
# =========================
head(df)
str(df)
colnames(df)

# =========================
# 4. Conversion en numérique
# =========================
df$SJ_Mean <- as.numeric(df$SJ_Mean)
df$CMJ_Mean <- as.numeric(df$CMJ_Mean)

# =========================
# 5. Calcul du Delta
# =========================
df$Delta <- df$CMJ_Mean - df$SJ_Mean

# =========================
# 6. Statistiques descriptives
# =========================
mean_SJ <- mean(df$SJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_SJ   <- sd(df$SJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_CMJ <- mean(df$CMJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_CMJ   <- sd(df$CMJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_delta <- mean(df$Delta, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_delta   <- sd(df$Delta, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_SJ
sd_SJ
mean_CMJ
sd_CMJ
mean_delta
sd_delta

# =========================
# 7. Vérification de la normalité des différences
# =========================
shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(df$Delta)
shapiro_result

# =========================
# 8. Test t apparié
# =========================
ttest_result <- t.test(df$CMJ_Mean, df$SJ_Mean, paired = TRUE)
ttest_result

# =========================
# 9. Test non paramétrique en complément
#    (utile si normalité non respectée)
# =========================
wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(df$CMJ_Mean, df$SJ_Mean, paired = TRUE)
wilcox_result

# =========================
# 10. Taille d'effet
# =========================
effect_size <- cohen.d(df$CMJ_Mean, df$SJ_Mean, paired = TRUE)
effect_size
```
